description: A benign inflammatory skin condition producing annular rings of papules.
risk_factors: Some cases are associated with diabetes or other conditions

appearance.general: Smooth skin-coloured or erythematous papules arranged in rings, commonly on the hands, feet, elbows, or other extremities.

doctor_discussion_points: Discuss persistent, widespread, or atypical lesions and whether biopsy is needed.
